text: Refunds are allowed within 30 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging. The money is returned to the original payment method in 5 to 7 business days.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days for an extra fee.
Orders can be cancelled free of charge before they are dispatched. After dispatch you must return the item once it arrives.
You can track your order using the tracking link sent by email and SMS after dispatch, or under My Orders in the app.
We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking and cash on delivery for orders under 5000 rupees.
To reset your password choose Forgot Password on the login page and follow the link sent to your registered email.
If your item arrives damaged, upload a photo within 7 days in My Orders and we will send a free replacement or full refund.
Electronics carry a 12 month manufacturer warranty. Keep your invoice as proof of purchase for warranty claims.
You can change your delivery address before dispatch from My Orders. After dispatch the address cannot be changed.
Your GST invoice is available under My Orders and is also emailed after delivery.
Only one coupon code can be used per order and coupons cannot be applied to gift cards or after the order is placed.
Our support team is available by chat and phone from 9 am to 9 pm every day. Chat assistant is available 24 hours.
